context: Radial hierarchical edge bundling showing cross-department collaboration across 12 months; ~75 leaf nodes (6 departments, 3-5 teams each, 3-5 members per team) arranged on a circle with LCA-bundled edges colored by source department; month slider + play button animates temporal changes; hover highlights individual node connections
first_impression: Clean and readable at the January snapshot — 32 active edges with 0.18 alpha and strong bundling keep the interior uncluttered, and the 6-color TOL palette maps departments clearly to arcs.
what_works: The semi-transparent, heavily-bundled edges (beta=0.85 default) collapse what could be a hairball into legible department-to-department flow bands; the 6-color palette stays well under the 8-hue threshold and the colored arc rails make department regions immediately identifiable without needing to read labels.
what_doesnt: Several department labels ('Research', 'Operations') are rotated to near-vertical angles making them hard to read without tilting your head — this is a fixable layout issue; animation quality and the hover-highlight interaction (which is the primary way to read individual connections) cannot be assessed from the static screenshot, so the actual usability of the temporal playback remains unverified.
